text:
Sam Carter: IncidentBot just paged me — sudden spike of 500s for /v1/embeddings from eu-west-1. looks like fallback is trying chat-instruct variants.
IncidentBot: [ALERT] 500-rate from embeddings-route (eu-west-1) — error: incompatible_model_variant — 8m ago — triggered fallback policy.
Sam Carter: I'm seeing logs: alias 'emb_v2' was updated last deploy to point to model 'm-chat-instruct-v1' by the rollout job. that explains the incompatible schema.
Elaine Wu: paging in. oncall here. can you confirm customer impact?
Maria Lopez: CS ping — multiple customers reporting "embeddings are returning long text outputs" and downstream similarity jobs exploding. looks like 6 customers with high traffic.
Kai Roberts: Confirmed: requests that should return 768-d float vectors are returning text chunks. runtime returns 200 but payload is chat tokens. upstream client libs choke.
Sam Carter: Rolling logs snippet:
```
2024-10-12T14:18:03Z request id=... route=embeddings alias=emb_v2 -> model=m-chat-instruct-v1
error: incompatible_model_variant: model does not support embedding output
```
Jules Ng: Oof. How did alias get pointed at chat model? was this part of the canary?
Sam Carter: Looks like a rollout config for alias-prefix 'emb_' had a wildcard that matched both embedding and chat aliases. the rollout job applied a new version to 'emb_v*' groups due to a naming collision.
Elaine Wu: Immediate mitigation proposal: 1) pause fallback policy (so we don't loop across regions), 2) pin emb_v2 back to previous embedding model, 3) disable the rollout job that applied the wildcard. anyone object?
Kai Roberts: +1. also disable inter-region auto-fallback to prevent the loop where eu -> us -> ap runs same alias and gets same mismatch.
Sam Carter: Executing step 1: `rbac:PATCH /policy/fallbacks/embeddings disable=true` — done. observed error rate drop from 18% to 6% in 3m.
IncidentBot: Action logged by Sam Carter: fallback policy disabled for embeddings routes.
Maria Lopez: Notifying affected customers with post-start note. CS drafting message: "We're investigating embedding output mismatch; temporary mitigation applied; we'll follow up with RCA."
Jules Ng: Step 2: pin emb_v2 -> model m-embed-v1. Doing `alias.update('emb_v2', model='m-embed-v1', force=true)` now.
Sam Carter: Pin took. traffic for emb_v2 now routed to m-embed-v1 in eu-west-1 only. errors dropped to baseline.
Elaine Wu: Step 3: disabling the rollout job schedule and lock file created. `rollout-job: disabled by Elaine Wu #incident-1719999999`
Kai Roberts: I'm re-enabling regional routing after smoke tests. will wait 30m.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert suppressed by Elaine Wu.
PagerDuty: Pager acknowledged by Sam Carter. Severity set to Sev2 due to customer impact but limited scope.
Maria Lopez: Quick customer impact summary for internal: ~6 enterprise customers impacted, degraded embeddings for ~27 minutes, no data loss, downstream batch jobs failed and retried. CS will escalate to accounts with SLA questions.
Sam Carter: Oncall handoff: Elaine, I need you to take lead for next 4 hours. I'll stick on followups and RCA.
Elaine Wu: Taking lead. Kai/Jules please add a follow-up ticket for rollout wildcard hardening and alias name validation.
Jules Ng: Created ticket: INF-9876 "Prevent wildcard rollout from matching cross-variant aliases" with PR checklist: alias validation, rollout dry-run warning, and rollout-ui confirm step.
Kai Roberts: We'll also add an automated smoke test for embedding routes after alias updates. assigned to eng-runtime.
Sam Carter: Post-incident checklist done: reverted alias, disabled fallback, paused rollout, informed CS. leaving note: need to audit all aliases with 'emb_' prefix vs 'chat_' naming overlap.
Elaine Wu: Postmortem owners: Sam + Kai + Jules. Maria will draft customer-facing timeline. Target: postmortem in 72 hours.
Maria Lopez: Draft message to customers (sent to legal for review): "We experienced a routing misconfiguration where a model alias used for embeddings pointed to a chat model during a rollout, causing incorrect outputs for embeddings. We have reverted the alias and applied a temporary mitigation to fallback policies. We will share a full RCA within 72 hours."
Sam Carter: Learning: fallback should not try incompatible model types — enforcement needed in routing layer to detect variant compatibility before routing/fallback. Adding to Optimize backlog.
Jules Ng: Adding runtime validation: reject alias updates that change model 'output_type' if alias has traffic. also fail safe: if routing encounters incompatible variant, return 503 instead of silent fallback.
Elaine Wu: Final operational note: re-enabled fallback policies at 1720003000 after verification but with a stricter compatibility check flag enabled. Monitoring for 2h.
Sam Carter: Closing slack thread for incident — will update postmortem link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
Maria Lopez: Thanks team — sending customer follow-ups now. :pray:
